images.alt:
Promotional image from the Ministry for Pacific Peoples that shows 4 Tongan men wearing woven garments and red neck adornments. Three of them are playing musical instruments (cornet, guitar, drum) the fourth is standing in front of them and smiling.
Text reads "16-22 'Aokosi / Lea Faka-Tonga / 2026 Pacific language weeks"

post.text:
Uike Kātoanga’i ‘o e Lea Faka-Tonga - Tonga Language Week starts on Sunday, 16 August.
Make a Tongan ribbon necklace at our after school craft at New Brighton Library on Monday, or find resources about Tongan language and culture on our website: my.christchurchcitylibraries.com/tongan-langu... ^MT

source.agency_name: Christchurch City Libraries (Ngā Kete Wānanga o Ōtautahi)
